statement: Arts5–6 enumerate the five nonsingular real species with line counts27,15,7,3,3. The preceding existence statement realizes all cases.

source.version: Original Philosophical Transactions153(1863),193–241; JSTOR original-journal scan

scope: Nonsingular real cubic surfaces in real projective three-space; count real projective lines, not only lines with a specified affine incidence.
notes: The two3-line species are distinguished by additional geometry. Equal real counts do not identify chambers.
